name: [🐟] Fish Incremental
desc:
🐠 Welcome to Fish Incremental! 🐠

🐟 Collect Fish to buy powerful upgrades.
✨ Discover rare fish to boost your strength even more.
📈 Progress through unique stages to unlock special upgrades.
🏆 Automate your land and rise to become the #1 Fish collector!

👍 Drop a like and favourite the game to support future updates.

🔔 Join the Roblox group for a pink name in game +1 Gem every hour!

🔔 Join our community server for update logs, sneak peeks, and leaks!

Inspired by: Circle Incremental, Upgrade Trees, Corn Incremental, Sticks Incremental
